questions.question: धृतराः सञ्जयं प्रित िकं प्रं अकरोत् ?
questions.solution_html: Verified solution established per official university examination criteria.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
questions.final_answer: धमᭅᭃेᮢे क ुᱧᭃेᮢे युयु᭜सवः समवेताः मामकाः पा᭛डवा᳟ैव ᳰकमक ु वᭅ᭠त इित ᮧ᳤म् अपृ᭒छत्।

questions.question: योगस्थः कुरु कमािण – इत्याथः भाष्ये कथं प्रदिशतः ?
questions.solution_html: Verified solution established per official university examination criteria.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
questions.final_answer: योग᭭थः सन् कमाᭅिण क ुᱧ, क े वलमी᳡राराधनाथᭅम्। तᮢािप ई᳡रो मे तु᭬यतु इित स᭑गं ᭜य᭍᭜वा धनᲳय।

questions.question: वायुः कथं नाशयित ?

questions.final_answer: शोषणेन।

questions.question: ृितिवभ्रमः काद् भवित ?

questions.final_answer: स᭥मोहा᭜᭭मृितिव᮪मः भवित।

questions.question: इयािण इयाथः कथिमव उपसंहरित ?
questions.solution_html: Verified solution established per official university examination criteria.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
questions.final_answer: यथा संहरते क ू मᭅः सवᭅशः तथा इि᭠ᮤयाणीि᭠ᮤयाथᱷ᭤यः संहरित।

questions.question: ज्ञानिना स्वातन्ेण पुरुषाथहेतुः। कात् ?
questions.solution_html: Verified solution established per official university examination criteria.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
questions.final_answer: ᭄ानकमᭅणोः िभ᳖पुᱧषानु᳧ेयतया तयोः समुᲬयास᭥भवात्।

questions.question: " मोघं पाथ स जीवित " । कः ?
questions.solution_html: Verified solution established per official university examination criteria.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
questions.final_answer: वेदय᭄पूवᭅकम् ई᳡रेण ᮧवᳶतᭅतं चᮓं यः कणाᭅिधक ृ तः नानुवतᭅयित सः अघायुः इि᭠ᮤयारामः मोघं जीवित।

questions.question: अहं एषां मम एते इत्येवं भ्रान्तप्रत्ययात् कथं संभवित यथाग्रात् िलखत।
questions.solution_html: Verified solution established per official university examination criteria.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
questions.final_answer: इित भा᭬यकारोᲦवचनमᮢ समाधानᱨपेण देयम्।

questions.question: अुपूणाकुलेक्षणं िवषीदन्तम् अजुनं मधुसूदनः िकमुवाच ?
questions.solution_html: Verified solution established per official university examination criteria.

questions.question: अुदयिनेयसहेतुः धमः कैः अनुीयमानः इित िलखत।
questions.solution_html: Verified solution established per official university examination criteria.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
questions.final_answer: उपो᳃ातभा᭬यो ᮧोᲦं धमᭅलᭃणं, ᮧवृितिनवृिᱫभेदेन धमᭅ᳇ैिव᭟यं च ᮧदशᭅयेत्। ततः तौ क े᭤यः उपᳰद᳥ौ इित

questions.question: महतो भयात् धम ायते - िवशदयत।
questions.solution_html: Verified solution established per official university examination criteria.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
questions.final_answer: अ᭭य ता᭜पयᭅम्।

questions.question: भीादीनां िनत्यं कथिमित िलखत।
questions.solution_html: Verified solution established per official university examination criteria.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
questions.final_answer: ᭜वेवादं जातु नासिम᭜याᳰदना। एते भी᭬मादयः अशो᭒याः यत᭭ये िन᭜याः।

questions.question: ‘ युध्यस्वेित अनुवादमां न िविधः ’ – सप्रसं व्याात।
questions.solution_html: Verified solution established per official university examination criteria.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
questions.final_answer: कतᭅ᳞ᮧितब᭠धापनयनमाᮢं भगवता ᳰᮓयते। त᭭मा᳒ु᭟य᭭व इित अनुवादमाᮢं न िविधः।

questions.question: ‘ बुयुो जहातीह ’ इत्यािदोकं यथाभाष्यं िवशदयत।
questions.solution_html: Verified solution established per official university examination criteria.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
questions.final_answer: ि᳇तीया᭟याये पᲱाशᱫमः ᳣ोकः बुि᳍युᲦो जहातीह उभे सुक ृ तदु᭬क ृ ते। त᭭मा᳒ोगाय यु᭔य᭭व योगः कमᭅसु

questions.question: आत्मवैिवधेयात्मा प्रसादमिधगच्छित – ोकं व्याात।
questions.solution_html: Verified solution established per official university examination criteria.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
questions.final_answer: ि᳇तीया᭟याये चतु᭬षि᳥तमः ᳣ोकः भवित – राग᳇ेषिवयुᲦै᭭तु िवषयािनि᭠ᮤयै᳟रन्। आ᭜मव᭫यैᳶवᭅधेया᭜मा

questions.question: तात् सवगतं ब्रह्म िनत्यं यज्ञे प्रितितम् ' । कात् इित िवशदयत।
questions.solution_html: Verified solution established per official university examination criteria.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
questions.final_answer: अ᳖ा᳊वि᭠त भूतािन.. इित तृतीया᭟याय᭭य चतुशᭅतम᳣ोकः तथा कमᭅ ᮩᳬो᳊वं िवि᳍ इित पᲱदशतम᳣ोक᳟

questions.question: कामोधौ कथं ज्ञानमावृणोित इित िवशदयत।
questions.solution_html: Verified solution established per official university examination criteria.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
questions.final_answer: धूमेन आिᮯयते वि᭮नः यथादशᲃ इ᭜याᳰदतृतीया᭟यायगत᳣ोकोऽᮢ ᳞ा᭎येयः।

questions.question: स घोषो धातरााणां हृदयािन व्यदारयत् - कीदृशः घोषः ? िवशदयत।
questions.solution_html: श᭑खाः भेयᭅ᳟ पणवानकगोमुखा᳟ अ᭤यह᭠य᭠त। यु᳍ो᳒ुᲦानां रा᭄ां सेनयो᳟ म᭑गल᭟विनः अᮢ व4᭛यते।
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
questions.final_answer: पा᭛डवानां त᭜संबि᭠धनां च श᭑खनादान् व᭛यᭅते। सः श᭣दः कौरवे᭤यः ᱡदयभेदकः आसीत् इित अᮢ सू᭒यते।

questions.question: ‘ तात् िवशेिषतािवियात्मदिशनः िवदुषो मुमुक्षोश्च सवकमसास एवािधकारः ’ – यथाभाष्यं समथयत।
questions.solution_html: Verified solution established per official university examination criteria.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
questions.final_answer: ि᳇तीया᭟याये एकᳲवंशिततमः ᳣ोकः भवित वेदािवनािशनिम᭜याᳰदᱨपः। त᭭य भा᭬यमाि᮰᭜य अयं ᮧ᳤ः

questions.question: स्थतप्रज्ञस्वरूपं भगवीताभाष्यानुसारं िवशदयत।
questions.solution_html: Verified solution established per official university examination criteria.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
questions.final_answer: भगव᳎ीतायाः ि᳇तीया᭟याये पᲱपᲱाशᱫम᳣ोकादार᭤य आअ᭟यायपयᭅ᭠तम् उᲦानां ᳣ोकानां ᳞ा᭎या

questions.question: कमयोगसारं संिक्षप्य िलखत।
questions.solution_html: Verified solution established per official university examination criteria.
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
questions.final_answer: भगव᳄ीतायाः तृतीया᭟याय᭭य तृतीय᳣ोकादार᭤य ᳲᮢंश᭜पयᭅ᭠त᳣ोकानामाशयः अᮢ संिᭃ᭡य ले᭎यः।
